title: Rsynapse productivity components
description: Calibration inputs and explicit goals. No composite productivity score or personal-time penalty weights have been chosen.

panels.title: Today — productive background overlap
panels.description: Wall-time union: you are input-idle, unlocked, focused on another window/session, and at least one explicitly work-classified or open-goal-related root agent is thinking or using tools. Parallel agents do not multiply credit. Compaction/subagents/personal/unknown agents are excluded.

targets.target: alias(sumSeries(keepLastValue(rsynapse.productivity.today.idle_agents_with_idle_human_seconds.state), multiplySeries(keepLastValue(rsynapse.productivity.today.idle_agents_with_idle_human_active.state), maxSeries(constantLine(0), diffSeries(scale(constantLine(${__to}), 0.001), keepLastValue(rsynapse.productivity.today.checkpoint.state))))), 'Work agents idle while you idle')

panels.title: Today — personal time and classification coverage
panels.description: Personal active/idle time is measured separately for future penalties. Neither includes lock. Unclassified active time reveals missing configuration; context names are not heuristically classified.

panels.title: Today — distraction / background-work overlap
panels.description: These are subsets, not additional time to add to the totals. Personal time with background work is exposed so future scoring cannot reward distraction more than waiting in a work context. Locked work is separate from the idle-on-another-window reward.

targets.target: alias(sumSeries(keepLastValue(rsynapse.productivity.today.personal_active_with_background_work_seconds.state), multiplySeries(keepLastValue(rsynapse.productivity.today.personal_active_with_background_work_active.state), maxSeries(constantLine(0), diffSeries(scale(constantLine(${__to}), 0.001), keepLastValue(rsynapse.productivity.today.checkpoint.state))))), 'Personal active with background work')

alias(sumSeries(keepLastValue(rsynapse.productivity.today.personal_idle_with_background_work_seconds.state), multiplySeries(keepLastValue(rsynapse.productivity.today.personal_idle_with_background_work_active.state), maxSeries(constantLine(0), diffSeries(scale(constantLine(${__to}), 0.001), keepLastValue(rsynapse.productivity.today.checkpoint.state))))), 'Personal idle with background work')

panels.title: Daily goals — plan, edit and review
panels.description: Goal records come directly from locus through the local dashboard API. Create and edit full titles, success criteria, priorities and statuses here; outcome goals can be linked to agent sessions. Steward only observes associations needed by its activity metrics.

panels.title: Daily productivity component log
panels.description: Event-closed union durations, stored durably in locus. Today may lag live panels until the next event. No retrospective overlap is invented from independent human/agent totals. Subsets must not be added to their parent totals.

options.content:
Manage goals in the editor above: select the day, add outcomes or habits, edit criteria, and update status explicitly. Outcome sessions can be linked through the Sessions button. Full records stay in locus, not Graphite.

Activity-context preferences remain collector configuration:
```sh
rsynapse-steward classify workspace personal personal
rsynapse-steward classify workspace rsynapse work
rsynapse-steward classify project /path/to/project work
rsynapse-steward classify list
```
Open outcome associations may qualify agent work; personal classification always vetoes credit. Habits never grant credit. No combined productivity score is finalized.
